f.n: Murray Australian Marine Park - Marine National Park Zone - South-east
f.pu: To protect the ecosystem and allow for passive recreation.
f.re: 1. Commercial and recreational fishing are prohibited. Fishing gear must be kept stowed and secured at all times during transit. 2. Mining is prohibited. 3. Anchoring is prohibited except in anchoring areas.
f.rn: South-east Commonwealth Marine Reserves Network – Management Plan 2013-23
